text: Chapter 1 contains no load-bearing prose passages. The OCR transcript for Martin Taylor's Complete Jazz Guitar Method Compilation surfaced only storefront/marketing metadata, page-end markers, and degraded notation artifacts (dashes, dollar signs, fragmentary OCR strings like 'BEGINNING OF THE END' and 'THEME: SUMMER NIGHT'). No teaching prose, technique definitions, rules, or annotated examples were recoverable from the 408-page compilation, which is known to combine Chord-Melody, Walking Basslines, and Single-Note Soloing volumes but whose body text the OCR rendered as essentially empty. Quotes[] is intentionally empty; nothing was fabricated to fill the chapter-guideline floor.
